applicability: Subject selection inside the normal task Intent Reviewer, and the task entry that opens it.
conditions: The catalogue read returns recorded invariant and family subjects for the selected repository, master and leaf.
The catalogue is read when the reviewer is mounted, keyed on the comparison (repository, master, leaf and history) and its snapshot generation, not on the global analytics document.
exclusions: Unavailable or refused catalogue reads do not establish an empty knowledge dataset.
The task entry's changed-intent summary read, which is not a catalogue read.
Re-reads caused by the reviewer's own refresh or by a new snapshot generation of the same comparison.
statement: The task entry reads no subject catalogue; the reviewer reads the recorded-subject catalogue once when it is opened, keyed on its comparison, and exposes that complete catalogue for subject selection inside the review.
